definitions.explanation: A credit card payment method where the cardholder pays a fixed monthly amount regardless of total purchases. Short for リボルビング{払|ばら}い. Known for accumulating high interest charges.

examples.japanese: リボ{払|ばら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支払|しはら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧リボ{払|ばら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}した→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧。
examples.english: I changed my card payment to revolving credit.

examples.japanese: リボ{払|ばら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{気|き}づかないうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らむ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you keep using revolving payments, your debt can grow without you noticing.

notes:
USAGE:
A widely discussed financial topic in Japan. Consumer protection groups and financial advisors often warn against using revolving payments due to the high interest rates (typically 15% annually). Credit card companies sometimes encourage switching to revolving payments through promotions or points campaigns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- リボ{払|ばら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧ (to switch to revolving payment)
- リボ{払|ばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧ (revolving payment balance)
- リボ{払|ばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧ (revolving payment fees)
- リボ{払|ばら}い⟦{地獄|じごく}→地獄：12053_jigoku⟧ (revolving payment hell — debt trap)
